summary: Comprehensive frontend-only test of new Blog feature (/blog index, /blog/:slug posts, SEO, cross-linking, sitemap, hash navigation regression). All 13 requested scenarios passed. No code changes needed.

test_results.blog_index_loads_with_cards_images_dates: PASS — title 'Blog — Google Reviews & Social Media Growth Guides | Social Media Review Stands', both post cards + images render
test_results.post1_opens_with_h1_author_image_meta_ca: PASS — H1 correct, author 'Social Media Review Stands Team' visible, featured image loads, meta description contains keyword, canonical=https://socialreviewstands.com/blog/setting-up-google-business-profile, BlogPosting JSON-LD (id=blog-post-jsonld) present
test_results.post1_crosslink_to_post2_anchor_text: PASS — anchor 'ways to increase followers on social media for your business' → /blog/increase-followers-social-media-business; navigation works
test_results.post2_crosslink_back_to_post1: PASS — anchor 'setting up Google Business Profile' → /blog/setting-up-google-business-profile
test_results.gold_cta_shop_the_stands: PASS — href=/#shop; clicking lands on homepage and #shop element exists (scroll triggered)
test_results.keep_reading_related_section: PASS — /blog/setting-up-google-business-profile shows related card to post 2 (and vice-versa)
test_results.navbar_blog_pages_section_links_prefix: PASS — nav Blog link present; Pricing href from /blog resolves to '/#shop' so inbound-hash scroll on home works
test_results.sitemap_contents: PASS — /sitemap.xml includes /blog and both post URLs, excludes /thank-you
test_results.regression_hero_video_and_unknown_slug: PASS — hero video autoplays muted with 'Tap for sound' button visible (verified via screenshot); /blog/does-not-exist redirects to /blog
test_results.mobile_375px_cards_stack_hamburger_blog: PASS — hamburger menu opens and includes Blog link; blog index renders responsively

critical_code_review_comments: Minor: blogPosts.json line 15 has 'a uncomfortable truth' (should be 'an uncomfortable truth'). Content typo, not blocking.
Minor: BlogIndex.jsx renders dates as raw ISO 'YYYY-MM-DD'. Consider formatting (e.g., 'Oct 25, 2026') for presentation polish. Not required by spec.
generate-sitemap.mjs correctly runs on prebuild/prestart; keeps /thank-you out as intended.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Blog feature fully verified against preview URL https://tap-for-reviews-1.preview.emergentagent.com on 2026-10-25. Both posts render, cross-link, pass SEO checks (meta/canonical/JSON-LD), CTA to /#shop works via hash-scroll effect in App.js Landing useEffect. Sitemap auto-generates via scripts/generate-sitemap.mjs; do not hand-edit public/sitemap.xml. If retesting hero video via Playwright, note there are TWO <video> elements (desktop+mobile variants) — use data-testid 'hero-video-mobile' or 'hero-video-desktop' not a bare 'video' selector.
